missing.why: the guide's SACKS section (p585) prints only Seasons Leading Team, Career and Season; there is no single-game sacks list anywhere in the regular-season individual records (pp. 568-590) or the all-time leaders (pp. 563-567), and a search of the whole guide text found only bio sentences about single games (e.g. 'one of seven players in franchise history to record 3.0 sacks in a single game'), no ranked list

notes: Source: Texans 2026 media guide, TEXANS RECORDS section (TOC: all-time/year-by-year leaders 563-567, Regular Season Individual Records 568-590). PDF page = printed page number in this guide. Regular season only; postseason (614-626), team (591-613, 627-638) and opponent rows ignored.

through_season 2025: the 2026 guide's year-by-year tables end with 2025 (first rows of pp. 565-567 are 2025), the TOC lists '2025 Regular Season Statistical Leaders', and the records include the last regular-season game, Texans vs. Indianapolis on 1/4/26 (pp. 586, 588, 589).

Ranks are not printed in this guide. rank = position in printed order; rows printed under one shared value cell (tie group) are marked tie:true, the first row takes rank = its position and continuation rows share it (competition ranking). A continuation row's raw is written '[value] text' because the value is printed only once per group.

Headings: the black/red section bars on pp. 563-590 render as garbled glyphs in the page images and in the IA OCR (font problem), but this PDF has an embedded text layer (pdftotext -layout) that carries the real headings (RUSHING YARDS GAINED, PASSING TOUCHDOWNS, RECEPTIONS, RECEIVING YARDS GAINED, TOTAL TACKLES, SACKS, ...). Every list was assigned to its category from those headings, then every row was re-checked against the text layer (value, name, years/date, order, and that no further row follows the last transcribed row). 'title' = section heading as printed + the sub-heading (Career / Season / Game); for the p563/p564 tables it is the table heading.

'Nx - last: NAME' rows (e.g. '5x - last: C.J. Stroud vs. Tampa Bay, 11/5/23'): the guide prints one line for N games that tied at that value and names only the latest one. These rows carry tie:true and are NOT sole holders; treat them as weaker evidence than a named record row.
Domanick Williams (marked # in the guide) = 'known as Domanick Davis prior to 2006' (guide footnote). name is stored as 'Domanick Williams'; raw keeps the printed 'Domanick Williams #'.

Game lists: the guide prints dates with 2-digit years (9/12/10); the years field has the 4-digit year added (all Texans games are 2002 or later); raw is as printed. Exception printed with 4 digits: 'Joe Mixon at Indianapolis, 9/8/2024'.

Guide-internal inconsistencies found (values transcribed as printed in the list used): (1) career passing yards table p563 prints Ryan Fitzpatrick 2,483 above Case Keenum 2,486 (digits checked at 300 dpi; the value rises at position 10, the validator warns); (2) Jadeveon Clowney is 2011-18 in the p564 sacks table but 2014-18 in the p585 box; (3) season receptions: DeAndre Hopkins 2019 is 104 in the p576 box but 100 in the p565 year-by-year table (row marked uncertain); (4) season tackles: Zach Cunningham 2020 is 163 in the p584 box but 106+58=164 in the p567 year-by-year table (row marked uncertain); (5) Will Fuller V vs. Atlanta is dated 10/7/19 in the receiving-TD game list (p578) but 10/6/19 in the receptions and receiving-yards game lists (p576).

Tackles: the guide labels the box 'Total Tackles' (Solo + Assist) and gives no official/unofficial note; the p564 table prints Solo/Assist/Total and is ranked by Total. Sacks are official (franchise began 2002). Kareem Jackson's years are '2010-18' in the p564 tackles/interceptions tables (used here) but '2010-18, 2023' in the p584 Total Tackles box.

Career lists were taken from the longer all-time tables on pp. 563-564 where the table is ranked by the exact stat (passing yards, rushing yards, receiving yards, sacks, interceptions, tackles) and from the p570/574/575/577 Individual Records boxes for touchdown passes, rushing touchdowns, receptions and receiving touchdowns; every career number appears in both places where both exist.
